label: permission-canary
argv: This is only a harmless runtime permission test, not an audit. Use run_command exactly once to run: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; Path('native-canary.txt').write_text('CANARY_OK\n'); print(Path('native-canary.txt').read_text())" . Use the current workspace as cwd, then reply CANARY_OK. Do not read any other files, use subagents, or access the network.
